threads.body: This changes the installable `instruments` extra to Agno 3, but `AgnoInstrumentor.instrumentation_dependencies()` still returns `_instruments = ("agno >= 2.0.0, < 3",)` from `src/opentelemetry/instrumentation/genai/agno/package.py`. Auto-instrumentation will therefore continue to reject the supported Agno 3 runtime (and the existing dependency test still asserts the old range); update the reported dependency and its test together with this bound.
